title: Cruise brief — Mon Oct 5, 2026
text: [RCL] Royal Caribbean shares rallied 17% over the week on growing enthusiasm for the Sandals resorts joint venture; Citi dropped its 90-day upside catalyst watch (Buy, $362 target), saying the move is now priced in. [NCLH] Norwegian jumped roughly 3.5% Friday as its $750M senior notes offering (refinancing 2028 debt) closed and sector demand sentiment stayed firm. Hurricane Rachel kept disrupting Mexican Riviera sailings over the weekend, hitting Carnival and Princess directly — Grand Princess lost its Cabo San Lucas call Oct 2, and Carnival Panorama made a second itinerary change before returning to Long Beach Oct 4.
